description: This file defines classes and interfaces for managing Dobby containers within the WPEFramework's process container framework. It includes class declarations for DobbyContainer and DobbyContainerAdministrator, along with their methods and member variables, as well as external dependencies and constants related to container configuration.

classes.name: DobbyContainer
classes.description: Represents a Dobby container, providing methods to control and query container state, memory, processor info, and network interfaces.

classes.name: DobbyContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages DobbyContainer instances, handles container creation, destruction, and logging, and interacts with Dobby IPC services.

methods.name: DobbyContainer(const string& name, const string& path, const string& logPath, bool useSpecFile = false)
methods.description: Constructor for DobbyContainer, initializes container with specified parameters.

methods.name: Pid()
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container.

methods.name: IsRunning()
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start(const string& command, IStringIterator& parameters)
methods.description: Starts the container with the specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop(const uint32_t timeout)
methods.description: Stops the container, waiting up to the specified timeout.

methods.name: Memory()
methods.description: Returns memory information of the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo()
methods.description: Returns processor information of the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces()
methods.description: Returns network interface information of the container.

methods.name: DobbyContainerAdministrator()
methods.description: Constructor for the container administrator, initializes IPC and proxy services.

methods.name: Container(const string& id, IStringIterator& searchpaths, const string& logpath, const string& configuration)
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container instance based on provided ID and configuration.

methods.name: Logging(const string& logDir, const string& loggingOptions)
methods.description: Configures logging options for container management.

methods.name: DestroyContainer(const string& name)
methods.description: Removes a container and cleans up resources.

methods.name: ContainerNameTaken(const string& name)
methods.description: Checks if a container name is already in use.

methods.name: containerStopCallback(int32_t cd, const std::string& containerId, IDobbyProxyEvents::ContainerState state, const void* params)
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container stops or changes state.
